## Brief description

*Game of Thrones* is an American fantasy drama television series created by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss for HBO. It is based on George R. R. Martin's book series *A Song of Ice and Fire*. The series premiered in 2011 and concluded in 2019 after eight seasons.
